description: Create a new document for the one-piece cover of a paperback (Umschlag: back cover, spine, front cover side by side) from the page_count of the interior, its trim size (trim_width_mm, trim_height_mm, Endformat) and the paper thickness per page as the printer states it (spine_per_page_mm or spine_per_page_in; the inch value wins when both are set): spine width = page_count × thickness, page width = 2 × trim width + spine, height = trim height. bleed_mm becomes the document bleed on all four sides (export with export_pdf and use_document_bleed true; the PDF then measures page size plus twice the bleed). safety_margin_mm sets the margins (Satzspiegel guides) on all sides. Vertical guides mark both spine folds; spine_safety_mm adds two guides inside the spine for spine text. barcode_area {width_mm, height_mm, offset_x_mm (from the spine fold), offset_y_mm (from the bottom trim)} reserves the space for the barcode on the back cover as a non-printing empty frame named barcode_area. Every value can come from the call or the server configuration (print_on_demand); take them from the printer's current specification. The new document is unsaved (save_document with path). Returns document_id, name, page_id, page_count, spine_width_mm, spine_width_in, trim_size and size_with_bleed {width/height in mm, pt and in}, bleed_mm, safety_margin_mm, back_cover_mm, spine_mm, front_cover_mm {x, width}, guides[] {guide_id, role, position_mm}, barcode_frame_id and barcode_area_mm.

barcode_area.description: Space for the barcode on the back cover. Default: the configured area, otherwise none.

bleed_mm.description: Bleed on all sides in mm. Default: the configured value, otherwise 0 with a warning.

safety_margin_mm.description: Margin on all sides in mm. Default: the configured value, otherwise 0.

spine_per_page_in.description: Paper thickness per page in inches (wins over spine_per_page_mm).

spine_per_page_mm.description: Paper thickness per page in mm. Default: the configured value.

spine_safety_mm.description: Distance of the spine text guides from each fold in mm. Default: the configured value, otherwise none.

trim_height_mm.description: Required. Trim height of the book in mm.

trim_width_mm.description: Required. Trim width of the book in mm.

name: create_book_cover
title: Create a book cover document
